question: 0.4.1: why is MTP acceptance low when the model samples, what can raise it without changing the output distribution, and how long should a sampled request's draft be?
machine: GMKtec EVO-X2 class, Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (gfx1151), 128 GB, 96 GB carve
model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS, MTP draft head shared-Q4_K_M with its own IQ4_XS LM head
protocol: tmp/spec/spec_accept.py through tmp/kvr/with_server.py (the app's profile; parallel 4 unless noted): N chat requests at once with the user's prompt '重新来一篇武侠方面的，5000字', Jan's sampling (temperature 0.7, top_k 20, top_p 0.8; min_p the server's 0.05), 1200 tokens each, a new seed per conversation and round, three rounds; tok/s summed = tokens over each round's wall time, averaged over rounds

method.speculative_sampling: Leviathan et al. 2023, Chen et al. 2023: the draft drawn from q (the draft head's top ten candidates through the target's top-k, top-p and min-p at temperature 1, then softmax at the target's temperature), a draft token accepted with probability min(1, p(x)/q(x)), a rejected one replaced by a draw from max(0, p - q), a draw from p after a draft accepted whole; p = the target chain's samplers but dist, then dist's softmax
method.expected_acceptance_stats: STRIX_SPEC_SAMPLING_STATS=1: at every verified position, sum_y min(p(y), q'(y)) for q' = q's support at temperature temp*s, and p(top token of q) for the greedy draft - both on the same contexts
method.monte_carlo: tools/spec_sampling_mc.py: the shipped functions compiled alone; one position, 35 parameter sets x 400K draws: output ~ p, draft ~ q, acceptance = sum min(p,q) (all within 5 sigma); streams of drafts of 1-3 tokens cut by a confidence rule on q: the joint law of three tokens = p's (3 streams, 3-9M steps); a control that drops drafts shorter than 2 is biased (chi2 z 1694)

draft_head_precision.note: separate runs, different texts: about +-2 points between runs
draft_head_precision.format: first: [drawn from q, greedy draft] expected; overall = accepted / drafted

ab_vs_0_4_0.log: tmp/spec/ab042.log, alternated old / new / old / new, seeds 8000, the app's profile (8 slots)
ab_vs_0_4_0.note: each build gives the same tokens for the same seed run to run (identical counts in its two runs)
